text:
rohit: Heads-up — saw weird residency streaks in prod yesterday after a long-form chat load. Hit rate looked fine but memory kept creeping.

jess: where are you seeing it? dashboard link?

rohit: eng-runtime KV dashboard -> per-host residency heatmap. Pattern: single process holds fragments for > 30m in contiguous runs, then eviction waves. Suspect fragmentation + cold eviction rollups.

sam: can you paste the timeframe and sample query?

rohit: timeframe 2026-03-15 02:10-03:40 UTC. Query I used:

```
sum by(host) (increase(kvcache_evictions_total{env=\"prod\"}[5m]))
/ sum by(host) (increase(kvcache_fetches_total{env=\"prod\"}[5m]))
```

looks like bursty eviction-rate spikes even though hit_ratio ~0.92 overall.

jess: maybe sampling skews low-frequency evictions. We should add a \"contiguous_residency_seconds\" counter per frag that increments while fragment is resident, emits on eviction.

lin: +1 on that. Also want \"eviction_wave_id\" tagging to group rapid consecutive evictions. Could be helpful for join on traces.

perf-bot: perf-alert: added alert kv.eviction_wave_rate_high for host > 10 waves in 10m.

rohit: proposal: new metrics:
- kvcache_fragment_residency_seconds (histogram buckets)
- kvcache_eviction_wave_count (counter)
- kvcache_eviction_wave_duration_seconds (gauge on active wave)
- kvcache_fragment_reuse_ratio per hotset

jess: dashboard panels to add:
- \"Residency streaks\" heatmap (host vs contiguous_residency_seconds)
- \"Eviction waves\" timeline with wave_count stacked per host
- \"Fragment reuse\" small multiples per model/seq_len bucket

sam: for PromQL examples:

```
# 90p contiguous residency per host
histogram_quantile(0.9, sum(rate(kvcache_fragment_residency_seconds_bucket[1h])) by (le, host))
```

```
sum by(host) (increase(kvcache_eviction_wave_count_total[10m]))
```

rohit: implementation note: emit contiguous residency at eviction time to avoid per-second overhead. We can maintain an in-memory start timestamp per frag and when evicted emit residency_seconds.

lin: sampling caution — we sample at 1/10 for metrics in high-throughput hosts; need a sample-aware denominator metric kvcache_sample_rate. Dashboard must normalize.

jess: also add a tracing span on first eviction in a wave: \"kvcache.eviction_wave.start\" with wave_id so we can correlate with kernel selection logs.

rohit: can someone stub out the exporter change? i can pick up dashboard mockups after.

sam: i'll add the alert and a Grafana folder; jess can draft panels; rohit — if you can PR the emitter in runtime we can dogfood in staging.

jess: noted. I'll mock panel JSON and paste.

perf-bot: deploy-bot: staged rollout scheduled to canary pool at 2026-03-18T18:00Z.

rohit: thanks. i'll open an RFC with implementation sketch and test plan.

lin: pinging @eng-sre for postmortem if it surfaces again. :eyes:
